newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Punjab cotton prices decline on unloading.
newsitem.headline: Indian Punjab cotton prices decline on unloading.

text.p: Indian Punjab cotton prices fell on selling by stockists while Gujarat varieties were unchanged on Monday, dealers said.
"Punjab varieties fell on unloading by stockists on reports of new crop arrivals at producing centres," a dealer said.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi lost 30/35 rupees to 825/860 rupees per maund (37.32 kg). In forward deals, Bengal-deshi was traded at 820/825 rupees for October delivery.
In spot deals Punjab F-414 slid 10 rupees to 1,910/1,930 rupees while Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) was steady at 12,000/12,200 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) for average variety.
